neighbours.label: end of a rule-breaking or non-compliance condition, just before its penalty (If people are caught …, / in violation of)
fire: If drivers are caught speeding near the school, they will lose their licence.
Students who are found cheating on the exam will be expelled.
If tenants fail to pay rent on time, a late fee will be added.
Guests found in violation of the dress code will be refused entry.
If you ignore the warning letters, the bank will take legal action.
Employees who break the safety rules will be sent home without pay.
If players refuse to obey the referee, the match will be stopped.
Any vendor caught selling alcohol to minors will be shut down.
quiet: If drivers are running late near the school, they can call ahead.
Students who are feeling tired before the exam may take a short break.
If tenants want to paint the walls, the landlord will supply the paint.
Guests dressed in bright colours will be photographed at the entry.
If you read the welcome letters, the bank will explain your options.
Employees who finish their shifts early will be sent home with pay.
If players want to swap shirts, the match staff will help them.
Any vendor selling fresh fruit to visitors will get a free stall.

notes: Card: 'in violation of this policy', 'If people are caught with weapons', 'If you do not adhere to this,'. Output promotes ignoring/forced/refusal. Probe: caught smoking 0.45, violation 0.36, 'do not follow these steps,' 0.44; neutral condition (hungry) 0.04.
